definitions.gloss: different color; color variation; alternate color version
definitions.explanation: The same item in a different color. Widely used in shopping, fashion, and gaming (especially for rare alternate-colored creatures in games).

examples.japanese: {色違|いろちが}いも{買|か}った。
examples.english: I also bought it in a different color.

examples.japanese: このシャツの{色違|いろちが}いはありますか。
examples.english: Do you have this shirt in another color?

examples.japanese: {気|き}に{入|い}ったので{色違|いろちが}いで{三枚|さんまい}{買|か}ってしまった。
examples.english: I liked it so much that I ended up buying three in different colors.

examples.japanese: {色違|いろちが}いのポケモンを{見|み}つけるのは{非常|ひじょう}に{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Finding a shiny Pokémon is extremely difficult.

notes:
A practical compound noun used daily in shopping and fashion to refer to the same product in a different color option. Also extremely popular in gaming culture, especially Pokémon, where {色違|いろちが}い refers to rare alternate-colored creatures (called "shiny" in English).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色違|いろちが}いで{買|か}う: to buy in different colors
- {色違|いろちが}いの{商品|しょうひん}: the same product in a different color
- {色違|いろちが}いのポケモン: shiny Pokémon
- {色違|いろちが}いを{集|あつ}める: to collect color variants

USAGE:
Often used with の as a modifier ({色違|いろちが}いのスカート) or with で to indicate manner ({色違|いろちが}いで{揃|そろ}える — to get a matching set in different colors). In online shopping, {色違|いろちが}い is a standard filter option.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {別|べつ}の{色|いろ}: another color (descriptive phrase, not a set term)
- カラーバリエーション: color variation (loanword, used in product catalogs)
